name: Tunkhannock 14-point Pitch
description: Tunkhannock 14-point Pitch is a Pennsylvania cutthroat or partnership Pitch variant using a 54-card deck (52 plus two jokers). Six cards each, then bid 3 to 15 (smudge); after bidding, discard three and replenish. Off-jack and jokers rank as trumps below the jack. Fourteen points (high, low, jack, off-jack, jokers, game, last trick, high spade, five) to win.

history.origins: Tunkhannock 14-point Pitch is a Pennsylvania regional variant of Pitch, related to Oklahoma 10-point Pitch. It is documented as normally played cutthroat by four players but can also be played in partnership. The game takes its name from the Tunkhannock region; detailed rules were preserved on Bill and Joe's archived 14 point Tunkhannock Pitch page (2000).
timeline: 20th century: Pennsylvania regional variant; documented on Bill and Joe's Tunkhannock Pitch page (archive 2000).

setup.dealing: Each player receives six cards, dealt three at a time (two rounds of three). After the bidding round, each player discards three cards face down and the dealer replenishes their hand to six cards from the undealt stock. Deal rotates clockwise after each hand.

rules.objective: Be the first to reach 14 points. Points are scored for high (highest trump in play), low (lowest trump in play), jack (jack of trumps), off-jack, high joker, low joker, game (most card points in tricks), last trick, high spade (1 each), and five of trumps (5 points). Bid to become pitcher and name trump; make your bid or be set back.
rules.gameplay: Six cards each, dealt in two rounds of three. One round of bidding (min 3, max smudge 15); dealer may steal with equal bid and must bid 3 if all pass. After bidding, each player discards three and is replenished to six from the stock. Pitcher leads to first trick (trump need not be led). Follow suit or trump; you may trump even when holding the led suit; may only play off-suit when unable to follow. Six tricks. Points awarded to the player winning each point card in a trick; game point to most card points in tricks. First to 14 wins.
keyRules: Off-jack and jokers rank as trumps below jack
